properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 29 at 5:52PM MDT until August 29 at 8:45PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern San Juan County in southeastern Utah...
Eastern Kane County in southern Utah...

* Until 845 PM MDT.

* At 552 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across Dry Rock Creek and lower portions of Hole in the
Rock Road down to Lake Powell, including Headless Hen Canyon,
Coyote Gulch, Forty Mile Gulch, Fifty Mile Gulch, and Davis Gulch.
Up to 0.75 inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks, streams, slot
canyons, and normally dry washes.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Dry Rock Creek and lower portions of Hole in the Rock Road down to
Lake Powell, including Headless Hen Canyon, Coyote Gulch, Forty
Mile Gulch, Fifty Mile Gulch, and Davis Gulch.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:45 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:45 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 29 at 4:39PM MST until August 29 at 6:45PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 439 PM MST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
0.8 and 1.7 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts
up to 0.1 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
South Tucson.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 19 between mile markers 61 and 63. Route 86 near mile
marker 171. Interstate 10 between mile markers 260 and 265.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
West Branch Santa Cruz River, Chico, Arroyo and Santa Cruz River.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 29 at 4:17PM MST until August 29 at 5:45PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 417 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated that thunderstorm and heavy
rain has ended over the Bright Angel Creek Basin below the Dragon
Bravo Fire scar. Between 0.25 and 0.75 inches of rain in about 30
minutes according to radar. Reports indicate that flash flooding is
ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding in and around the Bright
Angel Creek Basin below the Dragon Bravo Fire scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Bright Angel Creek Basin below the Dragon Bravo Fire scar.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Bright Angel Point, Phantom Ranch, Pipe Creek Resthouse, Point
Sublime, Cape Royal Point, Grand Canyon National Park, Buddha
Cloister and Vista Encantada.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 87 and 89...and
between river miles 99 and 100.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Ribbon Falls, Bright Angel Campground, North Rim Campground,
Cottonwood Campground, Clear Creek Camp Site, Upper Cremation Camp
Site, Lower Cremation Camp Site, Roy's Beach Camp Site, Boat Beach
Camp Site, Crystal Camp Site, Ego Beach Camp Site, Above Tuna Creek
Camp Site, Above Tuna Rapids Camp Site, Manzanita Rest Area and
Roaring Springs.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Bright Angel Creek, Crystal Creek, Colorado River, Clear Creek,
Tuna Creek, Unkar Creek, Shinumo Creek, Kwagunt Creek, North
Canyon, South Canyon, Zoroaster Canyon, Nankoweap Canyon, Lava
Canyon and Slate Creek.
properties.instruction:
Flash flooding is occurring or imminent downstream of the Dragon
Bravo Fire scar. Severe debris flow are expected downstream of the
North Rim into Bright Angel Creek and Crystal Creek. Campers and
hikers should get away from creeks and move to higher ground
immediately! Stay away or be swept away!
